Name: Alex's String Lights
Author: xBrince
Description:
[size=5][b]Alex's String Lights[/b][/size]
[i]Lights on everything. Every bulb in its own color.[/i]

[b][color=#ff9900]AI DISCLOSURE:[/color] [/b]I want to be completely transparent even if this disclosure makes you click off.[b] This mod is 100% AI-generated.[/b] Every sprite, every line of code and all of the text was made by an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic) from my ideas and direction. I did not draw the art or hand-write the code. Nothing from the base game or from other mods is included in the download. The pictures on this page are real screenshots from my game, cropped and lightly touched up (mouse pointer removed, one brightened), with title text added. I understand many people do not like AI sourced content which is exactly why I want to normalize full disclosures. I still think you should try my mods as they came from a place of love :). Feel free to use parts of the mod in your own work (see [b]Permissions[/b] below), just don't claim you made the assets or code yourself.

[size=4][b]What it adds[/b][/size]
Everything is added [i]alongside[/i] vanilla. Nothing is replaced, and it is safe to add to an existing save.

[list]
[*][b]57 string lights[/b] in three styles, each 1 to 5 tiles long: Bulb (big old-fashioned bulbs), Mini (small lamps, more of them) and Fairy (tiny lights on a fine wire).[/*]
[*][b]Four ways to put them up[/b]: hanging (the wire dips gently between two hooks), straight (the wire pulled taut and flat, with no dip, so it sits right along a roofline, fence or beam), on two posts (the posts stand on the ground and the wire is overhead), or on an indoor wall, pinned to the top row like a painting.[/*]
[*][b]They turn[/b]: hold a hanging, straight or post string and right-click to turn it up-down. It hangs in a dead-straight line down the screen, so four post strings make a boxed-off patio, market square or garden corner.[/*]
[*][b]6 Christmas trees[/b]: Small, Medium and Large, plain or snow-dusted, with the same patterns and the same editor as the strings.[/*]
[*][b]Real light[/b]: at dusk and at night every bulb glows, strings light the ground and whatever is near them, and strings on posts throw soft coloured pools of light onto the ground underneath. By day the bulbs just show their colour.[/*]
[*][b]73 pattern presets[/b] in nine categories: classic, single colours, whites, flashing, pulsing, chasing, twinkling, seasonal and moods.[/*]
[*][b]An in-game pattern editor[/b]: build your own with up to 8 colours, pick the style (Steady, Rotate, Twinkle, Pulse or Blink), the speed, the blending and the direction, then save it under your own name.[/*]
[*][b]Apply to all[/b]: put one pattern on every string and tree, or only on all Bulb strings, or only the straight ones, or only the ones on posts, in this area or everywhere in your save.[/*]
[*][b]Favorites[/b]: star the presets you like and a right-click steps through only those.[/*]
[*][b]The String Light Catalogue[/b]: one item from Robin that opens a shop with every string, tree and the desk below.[/*]
[*][b]The Light Manager Desk[/b] (new in 0.8.0): a little computer on a small desk. Click it and a window opens where you pick a pattern and put it on every string and tree, or only on one kind, in this area or everywhere, in one go.[/*]
[*][b]An Off colour[/b] (new in 0.8.0): switch a colour in a pattern off to leave a bulb dark for its turn, so you can have only one light on in a row, or a chase with gaps.[/*]
[*][b]Price settings[/b] (new in 0.8.0): from free to ten times the normal price, for the strings, the trees, the desk and the catalogue.[/*]
[*][b]Lit furniture from other mods[/b] (new in 0.8.0): other mods can ask String Lights to light up their furniture with the same patterns and editor. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53282]Pumpkin Patch[/url]'s glow jacks are the first. Pumpkin Carving, an add-on for Pumpkin Patch that is not released yet, is built to light the faces you carve, piece by piece (needs String Lights 0.9.0 or newer).[/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][b]Locking[/b] (new in 0.10.0): point at a string, tree or glowing pumpkin and press L, and it cannot be picked up and its pattern and colours cannot be changed, so a stray click does nothing. It keeps twinkling. A little padlock shows over your lights while you hold the key, and the [b]Light Manager Desk[/b] has Lock all and Unlock all. You can also lock the color only, so the light can still be picked up.[/color][/*]
[/list]


[size=4][b]Where to get things[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Buy the [b]String Light Catalogue[/b] from Robin (1,500g), place it anywhere and click it. Everything is sold there.[/*]
[*]Strings: 100g per tile + 50g (a 1x1 is 150g, a 1x5 is 550g); posts add 150g. Trees: Small 600g, Medium 1,000g, Large 1,600g; snow-dusted trees cost 150g more. The Light Manager Desk is 500g. All of these can be changed in the settings, down to free.[/*]
[*]Prefer to spawn them? They are in CJB Item Spawner, and the SMAPI console has [b]stringlights_give[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to use them[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Right-click[/b] a placed string or tree with empty hands for the next pattern; Shift + right-click goes back. The pattern's name shows at the bottom left.[/*]
[*][b]Ctrl + right-click[/b] a string or tree to open the pattern editor. What you clicked changes live while you edit, and [b]Peek[/b] hides the window so you can see it in the world.[/*]
[*][b]Turning:[/b] hold a hanging, straight or post string and right-click.[/*]
[*][b]Straight strings:[/b] place one like any furniture. No posts, nothing blocks you, and the bulbs hang level under a flat wire.[/*]
[*][b]Wall strings:[/b] hold one and point at an indoor wall. It jumps to the top row.[/*]
[*][b]Your own presets:[/b] Save as preset, then Rename it whatever you like.[/*]
[*][b]Off:[/b] in the editor, select a colour and press Turn off to make that slot dark. Red, Off, Off puts one lit bulb in every three.[/*]
[*][b]The desk:[/b] place the Light Manager Desk anywhere (indoors or out) and click it with empty hands. Choose which lights the pattern goes on with the first button, where with the second, then Apply to all. Lock all, Unlock all, Lock colour and Unlock colour (top right) use the same choice.[/*]
[*][b]Locking:[/b] point at a string, tree or glowing pumpkin and press [b]L[/b] to lock it (press again to unlock). A locked light cannot be picked up and its pattern and colours cannot be changed (not by a click, the editor or Apply to all, which skips it and says so). Hold L to see padlocks over your lights.[/*]
[*][b]Locking the colour only:[/b] set [b]LockColorKey[/b] (blank by default) in the settings menu, point at a light and press it. The pattern and colours are then fixed, but the light can still be picked up. The desk has Lock colour and Unlock colour for the same thing.[/*]
[/list]A full guide, including the SMAPI console commands, is in the README included in the download.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], for a settings page in the game.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher is [b]not[/b] needed.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the [b]StringLights[/b] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] folder, so you end up with [b]Mods\StringLights[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Updating:[/b] unzip over the old folder. Your settings (config.json), your own presets (user_patterns.json) and your stars (favorites.json) are kept, because the download never contains those files.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Options live in [b]config.json[/b] (created on first launch) or in Generic Mod Config Menu, and apply straight away:
[list]
[*][b]DefaultPattern[/b]: the pattern a new string starts on.[/*]
[*][b]EditorKey[/b]: the key you hold while right-clicking to open the editor. Left Ctrl by default.[/*]
[*][b]LockKey[/b], [b]LockColorKey[/b] and [b]LockIcons[/b]: the key that locks the light you point at (L by default, None turns it off), the key that locks only its pattern and colours (blank by default), and when padlock pictures show: while a lock key is held (default), always, or never.[/*]
[*][b]CycleOnlyQuickPatterns[/b] and [b]CycleOnlyFavorites[/b]: which presets a plain right-click steps through. The first 15 by default, or only your starred ones.[/*]
[*][b]PostsBlockWalking[/b]: off by default. On, the two end posts of a string block you, never the wire between them.[/*]
[*][b]Light and glow[/b]: strength, size and colour of the real light and the glow round each bulb, with a set for each kind of string and for the trees, plus the pools of light under strings on posts.[/*]
[*][b]Prices[/b]: [b]PricePercent[/b] (100 = normal, 0 = free, up to 1000) for every string, tree and the desk, and [b]CataloguePrice[/b] for Robin's catalogue. A free string cannot be sold for gold.[/*]
[*][b]Glowing pumpkins[/b]: a page for the light and glow of furniture added by other mods (kept dim on purpose).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Everything is new items with their own ids (Alex.StringLights_...), so it should coexist with other furniture and string-light mods. The mod patches how its own furniture is drawn, clicked and turned, and those patches leave other furniture alone. Written and tried on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.2. If you remove the mod, pick up your strings, trees and catalogue first: a save that still has them placed shows error items until you reinstall.

[size=4][b]Known limits[/b][/size]
This is a hobby mod that has so far been tried in one heavily modded single-player game.
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer has not been tested.[/b][/*]
[*]Wall strings assume the walls in a room are 3 tiles tall, which is the case for the standard rooms.[/*]
[*]Strings never block walking by default, and there is no solid "fence" kind yet.[/*]
[*]Trees do not turn, and there is one look each (plain or snow-dusted) in three sizes.[/*]
[*]The desk, the Off color, the price settings and the lit furniture from other mods (including carved pumpkins) are new in this update and have so far only been checked with automated tests, not played through. If something looks wrong, please tell me.[/*]
[*]A string that another mod (Precise Furniture) has moved a pixel at a time can be picked up again, but I could not reproduce the old problem, so if one still will not come up, type [b]stringlights_why[/b] next to it in the SMAPI console and send me what it prints. [b]stringlights_pickup[/b] takes your strings near you into your backpack whatever is stopping them.[/*]
[*]If a patch ever fails, the mod writes one line to the SMAPI log and carries on. If you report a problem, please upload your SMAPI log (smapi.io/log).[/*]
[*]The lock is new in this update. The color-only lock (its key, its striped padlock and the Lock color / Unlock color buttons) has so far only been checked with automated tests, and a quick in game test. If something looks wrong, please tell me.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]For mod authors: lit furniture[/b][/size]
Any mod can ask String Lights to light up a piece of its furniture by editing the data asset [b]Mods/Alex.StringLights/ExternalObjects[/b] (with Content Patcher, only when String Lights is installed). You say where the lit patches are on the picture and supply a glow-mask texture; String Lights draws them over your furniture and lights them with the same patterns, editor and light engine as the strings. Neither mod needs the other. The format is in the README included in the download, under [i]Other mods can add lit furniture[/i].
For furniture whose lit patches differ from piece to piece (a pumpkin carved in the game, for example), version 0.9.0 adds a small [b]C# API[/b]: [b]RegisterPiece[/b], [b]SetPatches[/b], [b]ClearPatches[/b] and [b]HasPatches[/b], reached with [b]helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IStringLightsApi>("Alex.StringLights")[/b]. A piece you give patches to is drawn, lit and edited exactly like a glow jack, and it is "All pumpkins" in Apply to all together with them. The interface and the rules are in the README as well. (Pumpkin Carving, not released yet, is the first mod to use it.)

Because this mod is entirely AI-generated, I want it to stay honest and shareable. You are welcome to use, edit, translate or remix any part of it in your own mods, as long as you:
[list=1]
[*]Do [b]not[/b] claim you created the assets or code yourself, and say plainly that they are AI-generated.[/*]
[*]Credit it: "Alex's String Lights by Alex (AI-generated with Claude)" with a link back to this page.[/*]
[*]Do not re-upload the unmodified mod, and do not sell it or put it behind a paywall.[/*]
[/list]The full terms are in [b]LICENSE.txt[/b] in the download.

Change Log:
Version 0.10.0 (this also contains 0.7.0, 0.8.0 and 0.9.0, which were never uploaded on their own):
- New: lock a light. Point at a string, tree or glowing pumpkin and press L (you can change the key) and it cannot be picked up, and its pattern and colours cannot be changed by a click, the editor or Apply to all. It keeps twinkling. A padlock shows over your lights while you hold the key (or always, or never: your choice in the settings).
- New: lock the colour only. The light keeps its pattern and colours but can still be picked up. Its key (LockColorKey) is blank until you choose one in the settings.
- New: Lock all, Unlock all, Lock colour and Unlock colour in the Light Manager Desk, for the same lights as Apply to all. Apply to all and stringlights_pickup leave locked lights alone.
- New: straight strings, the wire pulled flat with no dip and no posts, in all three styles and every length from 1 to 5 (15 new items, 57 string lights in all).
- New: the Light Manager Desk (500g, in the catalogue). Click it to put a pattern on every string and tree, or only on one kind, in this area or everywhere.
- New: an Off colour for patterns (a bulb that stays dark for its turn), for one light on in a row, or chases with gaps.
- New: price settings in the config menu, from free up to ten times normal, and a price for the catalogue.
- New: lit furniture from other mods. Pumpkin Patch's glow jacks light up with the same patterns and editor, and other mods can add theirs. A small C# API (version 1) lets a mod light one particular piece patch by patch: Pumpkin Carving (not released yet) will use it for the faces you carve.
- Fixed: wall strings and strings nudged a pixel at a time with Precise Furniture can be picked up again (I could not reproduce the old problem, so tell me if one still won't come up). New console commands: stringlights_why explains why a piece won't pick up, stringlights_pickup picks up the ones near you anyway.
- Nothing from 0.6.2 changed: item ids, prices, pictures, and your config.json, favorites.json and user_patterns.json all carry over.

Manifest.Name: Alex's String Lights
Manifest.Description: Bulb, Mini and Fairy string lights, 1 to 5 tiles long: hanging, pulled straight, on posts, or pinned to an indoor wall, and hanging, straight or post strings turn up-down (hold one and right-click). Plus Christmas trees in three sizes. Every bulb glows in its own colour, and a colour can be switched off to make chases and one-in-a-row patterns. Everything is in one String Light Catalogue from Robin. Click a string or tree to change its pattern, hold Ctrl and right-click to open the pattern editor, or put down the Light Manager Desk and set (or lock) every light at once. Point at a light and press L to lock it, so a stray click cannot pick it up or recolour it. Other mods can add lit furniture too (glowing pumpkins from Pumpkin Patch, pumpkins you carve yourself with Pumpkin Carving). Made entirely with AI (Claude by Anthropic): all art, code and data are AI-generated.
